posts.title: Upstream and Downstream Are Not Directions
posts.description: The incident review started with a sentence that sounded ordinary. “The downstream service returned bad data.” Everyone knew what the speaker meant.

posts.title: Turning Agent Work Into a System
posts.description: In the last post, I argued that prompting is not the system. The missing layer was the system that keeps work in a known, controlled state while it changes. That is what I started calling Ordo.

posts.title: From Prompting to Context. Still Not the System.
posts.description: Early on, prompting felt like the core problem. If you wrote better prompts, you got better results. That framing made sense for a while.
